title: Landing page
brief: Landing page for OpenJiuJitsu, served at / with the local-first web app at /app/. Primary color: red (#ef4444), no lime.

artboards.title: Scoreboard
artboards.tradeoff: Classic SaaS structure with a live IBJJF scoreboard as hero; clear and complete, but more conventional

artboards.title: Belt journey
artboards.tradeoff: Editorial narrative from white to black belt, one feature per stage; memorable and on-theme, but long to scroll

artboards.title: App first
artboards.tradeoff: Split hero with the real Home screen in a phone, then each area explained with real app data (seed library, IBJJF legality, belt round times); longer page, but shows exactly what the app does
